(viii) 
For every real estate leased or rented by a local government institution, the lease period during the
contract  period  shall  be  revised  every  three  years  from the date  of  the agreement  with respect  to
each  building  or  land,  on  the  valuation  of  the  government  assessor  or  a  chartered  assessor  and
successful conditions should be included in relevant tender notice and

(ix) 
It  should  be  published  in tender notice  that in addition  to  the  tax amount,  assessment  tax  should
also be paid for the required tax period and should come to agreement accordingly.
